# Yucore Industrial

> Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import and Export Co., Ltd. sources and exports industrial components from Nansha, Guangzhou. Trading name: Yucore Industrial.

Yucore Industrial is the trading name of Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import and Export Co., Ltd., a sourcing and export company in Nansha, Guangzhou. Since 2014 we have helped factories, distributors, system integrators, panel builders and maintenance teams source electrical and automation parts from China, including PLCs, VFDs, sensors, servo motors, circuit breakers and control cabinet components. Hydraulic parts and MRO spares can be included in the same order. Buyers can request one replacement item or a multi-brand bill of materials. We quote within 24 hours when the manufacturer, exact model or part number, quantity, destination country and required delivery date are provided. Availability, condition, source, warranty, unit price, lead time, packing and freight are confirmed in the written quotation before an order is placed. Sales contact: Ms. Summer, summer@yucore.com, +86 150 1848 5957.

Last updated: 2026-11-25

## Company facts

- Legal name: Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import and Export Co., Ltd.
- Chinese name: 广州市小彧進出口有限公司
- Trading name: Yucore Industrial
- Founded: 2014
- Address: A256, 1F, Shop 114, No. 3 & 4, Zhongjing 4th Street, Nansha District, Guangzhou, China
- Hours: Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 China Standard Time
- Sales contact: Ms. Summer
- Email: summer@yucore.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +86 150 1848 5957
- Website: https://gzyucore.com/
- Buyers: factories, panel builders, system integrators, distributors and maintenance teams in the Middle East, Europe, the United States and other markets

## What the company sources

- PLC: CPUs, I/O modules and controller accessories
- VFD: AC drives and motor-control accessories
- Sensors: proximity, photoelectric and process sensors
- Servo motors: servo motors, drives and motion accessories
- Circuit breakers: miniature and molded-case breakers and protection devices
- Control cabinets: relays, terminals, power supplies and panel parts
- Hydraulic parts and MRO spares: included when the buyer adds them to the same order
- 3D-printed parts and PCB boards: quote by drawing, Gerber, or part number. They can be included in the same export shipment as mechanical, hydraulic and automation components, subject to a written quotation. Lead time, Incoterms, packing and document responsibility are stated only in the quotation. Stock, production capacity and factory affiliation are not listed unless written there.
- Supply scope: 500+ supply channels
- Minimum order: none

## How to request a quote

Send the manufacturer, exact model or part number, quantity, destination country and required delivery date to summer@yucore.com or +86 150 1848 5957. A nameplate photo or BOM is helpful. A written quotation is sent within 24 hours when those details are provided.

The quotation confirms availability, condition, source, warranty, unit price, lead time, packing and freight for the requested part number. Catalog text is category guidance and is not a price or delivery commitment. Orders are exported from Nansha, Guangzhou.
